```yaml
name: Nuitka Build on Linux

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install nuitka
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Build with Nuitka
        run: |
          nuitka --standalone --onefile dirsearch.py --output-dir=build

      - name: Handle Nuitka output name differences
        run: |
          # Nuitka produces a binary named 'dirsearch' on Unix and 'dirsearch.exe' on Windows.
          # Ensure the artifact has a consistent name for downstream steps.
          if [ -f build/dirsearch ]; then
            echo "Unix binary found: build/dirsearch"
          elif [ -f build/dirsearch.exe ]; then
            echo "Windows binary found: build/dirsearch.exe, renaming to Unix style"
            mv build/dirsearch.exe build/dirsearch
          else
            echo "No expected binary found in build directory"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dirsearch-linux
          path: build/dirsearch
```
